limitations: This shows the FIELD collapses. It does not show what happens to the organisms: n=8, cells=8, maintenance=0, move-cost=0, so they have no reason to move and no cost for staying. Whether a population can survive on a collapsing field is a separate question, not answered here.
Only Policy::Stay, only uniform fields, only one seed. A moving population meets a different k on each cell each step, which this experiment does not exercise.
